disposition_mapping.rationale: Trial balance close confirmation remains a discrete gating step performed by the GL accountant, per KB-03 reporting-period discipline and FSP-R-10; only the status-reporting mechanism is modernised.

Posting of period-end adjustments and revenue cut-off verification is preserved as a single GL accountant step, continuing to consume the approved adjustment schedule and cut-off evidence per FSP-R-02 and FSP-R-06, and upholding accrual-basis and cutoff principles (KB-01, KB-03, KB-13).

Intercompany elimination is merged with FX translation into one consolidation-engine pass run by the group accountant, still consuming intercompany balances and transactions as required (FSP-R-03) and preserving full identification/elimination of intragroup positions per KB-14.

Foreign operation translation is merged into the same consolidation step as elimination, continuing to consume closing and average exchange rates (FSP-R-04) and keeping translation differences separately tracked to OCI per KB-07 and KB-08.

Mapping to statement line items is restructured around an automated mapping engine with human validation by Financial reporting, still consuming the statement line-item structure as required (FSP-R-05); the function and evidential basis per KB-02 are unchanged.

Drafting of primary statements and key notes survives as required (FSP-R-11) and continues to consume the accounting policy change and prior-period error record (FSP-R-07, KB-05, KB-06); it is merged with the tie-out function into one continuous drafting-and-verification step, and remains distinct in actor from management approval (FSP-R-08).

Unconstrained by design: analytical review and tie-out is absorbed into the drafting step as a continuous, system-assisted control rather than a separate downstream pass, preserving the evidential trail (KB-02) that links journals and reconciliations to reported balances while shortening cycle time.
Management review and approval survives unchanged in substance and actor (CFO), as required by FSP-R-09, and remains separated from the drafting actor per FSP-R-08.

Unconstrained by design: release/submission is restructured into a system-triggered action following recorded approval, removing manual handling latency while leaving the approval record (TS-06) as the substantive control point.

steps.description: Subledger closure and completion of reconciliations are confirmed via an automated close-status dashboard, establishing the closed, reconciled trial balance that gates all downstream statement preparation.
steps.name: Confirm trial balance close

steps.description: Approved period-end adjustments (accruals, provisions, deferrals, cut-off) are posted against the closed trial balance, with revenue cut-off evidence verified at the point of posting so period-end discipline is enforced before consolidation.
steps.name: Post period-end adjustments and verify cut-off

steps.description: Entity trial balances, including the foreign subsidiary, are consolidated in a single pass: intercompany balances and transactions are matched and eliminated, and foreign-currency results and positions are translated into the presentation currency using closing and average rates, with translation differences routed to other comprehensive income. Combining elimination and translation in one consolidation engine run removes handoff latency while keeping both computations fully auditable.
steps.name: Consolidate, eliminate intercompany, and translate foreign operations

steps.description: The consolidated and translated trial balance is mapped to the statement line-item structure using an automated mapping engine, with Financial reporting validating exceptions and structural changes.
steps.name: Map trial balance to statement line items

steps.description: The primary statements and key notes (accounting policies, revenue, FX, errors) are drafted, including disclosure of policy changes and prior-period errors, with analytical review and tie-out to the trial balance and supporting schedules performed continuously as the draft is built rather than as a separate downstream pass, shortening cycle time while preserving the evidential trail.
inputs: Accounting policy change and prior-period error record
steps.name: Draft primary statements, key notes, and continuous tie-out

steps.description: Management reviews the draft statements together with tie-out evidence and approves the financial statements. Performed by a different actor than drafting to preserve independent review.
steps.name: Management review and approval

steps.description: Approved financial statements are released or submitted through a system-triggered distribution step once approval is recorded, removing manual handling delay while leaving the approval record as the control point.
steps.name: Automated release and submission
